title: tel-national override only matches `_phone]`-suffixed co-applicant phones; a bare `co_applicant[N][phone]` would silently get `tel`
detail: The override keys off the literal `_phone]` suffix. A bare `co_applicant[N][phone]` bypasses it, normalizes to `phone`, and hits the exact `"phone" -> "tel"` rule — contradicting the doc-block claim that co-applicant phones get `tel-national` and that the split keeps every phone fillable. No test covers the bare-phone shape; field existence isn't confirmable from this diff alone, so impact is latent rather than proven.
recommended_fix: Gate the override on the normalized inner name (`inner_field_name(name)`) equaling `"phone"` or ending `_phone`, or broaden the guard to `ends_with(name, "phone]")`, so every co-applicant phone consistently resolves to `tel-national`.
